decisions.reason: The aloe vera line sits close to the core offer and has its own page, which signals it is meeting aspirations in a growing industry, so management has no shortfall prompting a search for alternatives.
A hyaluronic serum fits the established facial range and consumer demand, and with no evidence of a shortfall a small firm with modest slack would keep carrying this low-cost line extension.
A cleansing milk is a staple of a natural skincare range that uses existing in-house production, so without signs that it falls short of aspirations there is little reason to drop it.
